start.lede: This is not an installer download page. There is not yet a qualified Windows, macOS, or Linux installer. The commands below are the real upstream entry recorded in the repository README. Full desktop acceptance of this checkout is not complete.
start.status: No model key is bundled, and no live or paid inference is included. Do not claim a model is ready until a provider is configured. For development, set a product-specific DSH_HOME; do not silently treat a shared ~/.dsh as the release configuration.
start.req.p: Node ≥ 24.9, Git ≥ 2.26, and pnpm 11.28.5 enabled through Corepack (follow the root packageManager field; do not invent a different version and call it compatible).
start.steps.h: Run these at the repository root
start.s3p: Then open local port 3081 in a browser. This is source-running, not an accepted desktop installer.
start.win.h: A Windows installer is still pending
start.win.p: A qualified Windows x64 installer must pass the release gate and appear as a public (non-draft) Release asset. Until then, do not treat older EXE or MSI files from other repositories as 湛箴_ymzz.
foot.priv: No trackers, no third-party font network requests, and no analytics. Language and theme stay in this browser.
notfound.h: This page is not on this site
notfound.p: This may be an old link, or a Pages path written as the site root instead of /ymzz/. Return home or start from the source guide.
hero.eyebrow: Open source · 晏銘湛箴 / Ya-MiC

hero.lede: A local-first agent distribution built on the full official DeepSeek Harness and extended with native plugins. The runtime is not rewritten, and native component placement is preserved. Everything is a plugin.
hero.status: There is no accepted public installer yet. A Windows package has not been released or accepted. macOS and Linux desktop packages are outside the current guarantee. Please run from source first.
status.h: This is the product site, not a finished cross-platform installer store
status.p: The repository is public on GitHub's master branch. Application naming, the four Wenrun themes, and preinstalled plugins are still being integrated. This page will not describe 稟冊's older draft installers as a release of this agent.
status.1p: This is the currently truthful entry. You need Node, Git, and pnpm. Steps are on the start page.
status.2p: An x64 installer is planned after the release gate. It has not been published or accepted yet.
status.3p: Planned, not guaranteed, and there is no qualified installer to download.
status.4p: Planned. Upstream DeepSeek Harness has no Linux desktop release target, and this site does not pretend otherwise.
get.h: Run the source first; installers wait for a qualified release
get.p: The main call to action only points at actually available qualified releases. Until a public Release has accepted assets, this page will not show an empty download button.
get.pending: The releases page currently has no public version. If a non-draft qualified asset appears later, this section will list the real filename and link.
product.p: The agent body is an empty hub; skills and plugins are replaceable spokes. Local-first, zero telemetry, clean install and uninstall. MIT-licensed and commercially usable. This is not an official DeepSeek product.
product.1p: Built on the complete DeepSeek Harness, keeping native layout and component placement, not rewritten as a separate Tauri agent.
product.2p: New capabilities arrive through native plugins and the skill pool. No ymzz plugins are preinstalled yet; later updates will be maintainer-reviewed before they reach users.
product.3p: Cloud light, Cloud dark, Earth light, Earth dark. This website already switches them; in-app theme integration is not finished.
product.4p: Charging and payment will be connected by the author. This site has no payment interface and does not collect payment data.
plugins.h: The hub stays empty; the spokes can change
plugins.p: This page does not describe skills as built-in until they are actually wired into the app. Sources and licenses will be checked item by item before a release.
plat.h: What you can use now, and what you cannot
plat.win.p: Run from source; a qualified installer is not available yet.
plat.mac.p: No qualified installer to download. You may try running from source; that path is not accepted for this release.
plat.linux.s: Planned; upstream has no desktop release target
plat.linux.p: No qualified installer to download. You may try running from source; that path is not accepted for this release.
family.h: 稟冊 and the other sites remain, and remain themselves
family.p: 稟冊 is a separate local-first personal work-report / file-management desktop app (Tauri 2). Your files, AI conversation records, and review progress stay on your own computer. It is not this DSH agent, and its older installers are not this product.

family.bingce.p: Onboarding and setup for 稟冊, not the download page for 湛箴_ymzz.
family.official.p: Brand entry and Wenrun design demonstration.
family.wuyong.p: A local MCP resident sub-agent and dynamic skill pool.
family.wuwong.p: Local-first knowledge memory and sub-agent collaboration.

faq.h: Clear up the easy misunderstandings first
faq.1q: Can I download Windows, Mac, or Linux installers now?
faq.1a: Not yet. This product has no accepted public installer. If 稟冊 has draft packages, those belong to a different app, and some download pages require a GitHub sign-in.
faq.2q: How can I use it now?
faq.2a: Get the source from GitHub and follow the Node, Git, and pnpm steps on the start page. Until a model provider is configured, do not claim that a model is available.
faq.3a: No. 稟冊 is a local personal work-report / file-management app. 湛箴_ymzz is an agent distribution based on the full DeepSeek Harness. The two sites link to each other and do not replace each other.
faq.4q: Is my data sent to your servers?
faq.4a: This website does not collect accounts or conversations. Language and theme stay in your browser's localStorage. The product is local-first with zero telemetry. If you configure a cloud model yourself, that relationship is between you and that provider.
faq.5a: No. It is based on the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness and published by 晏銘湛箴. It does not represent DeepSeek officially.
faq.6a: Payment will be connected by the author and is not handled on this site. There is no pricing plan and no payment QR code here.
foot.legal: Based on DeepSeek Harness (MIT). Not an official DeepSeek product. The product icon is the author's artwork and is not relicensed as MIT by being placed in the repository.
family.page.p: These are checked public entry points. 稟冊 keeps its own files, conversations, reviews, and nickname flow. This page only links them; it does not import old installers into this agent.
family.self.p: This product site: a local-first agent on full DSH plus plugins.
